---

## The problem Attesté solves

1. **Most art collectors have no digital provenance records.** When an artwork changes hands, its story dies with the seller's memory.
2. **Most provenance still lives on paper.** A flood, fire, or lost folder destroys decades of context.
3. **Inherited collections become puzzles.** Heirs often can't name the artist, date, or source of inherited pieces.
4. **Working artists have no canonical place to issue source certificates** — provenance starts murky and stays murky.
5. **Collectors lack a single place to catalogue, verify, and share their collection.** They use spreadsheets, iPhone photo albums, or nothing.
6. **Galleries have no privacy-respecting way to understand their collector base.** Building CRMs from scratch is expensive; scraping data is unethical.
7. **Art fairs produce sensory overload.** Collectors meet 50 galleries in a day and can't remember which artworks they wanted to revisit.

---

## Product features (complete list)

### AI Art Scout
Photograph any artwork. Gemini 2.5 Flash vision analysis identifies:
- Likely artist (ranked by confidence)
- Medium (oil, acrylic, mixed media, print, sculpture, photograph, digital, etc.)
- Estimated period/style
- Similar artworks by the same or comparable artists
- Suggested catalogue title if none exists

Works on originals, prints, photographs, and sculptures. Handles low-light gallery photography reasonably well. Explicit confidence score on every identification; low-confidence results are flagged rather than guessed. `provenanceQuality` (0-5) caps AI confidence — invoice/receipt is king, AI is experimental only.

### Attesté Certificate
Every documented artwork can be issued a cryptographically-secured provenance certificate. Includes:
- Owner identity (pseudonymous hash if desired)
- Acquisition date and location
- Source (gallery, artist, auction, estate)
- Photograph fingerprint (SHA-256 of canonical image)
- Condition and valuation history
- Chain of custody if the artwork transfers

The certificate hash is published to an immutable append-only log. Collisions are detected automatically. Export as PDF with QR verification link. Public URLs at `https://atteste.art/cert/{16-char-sha256-prefix}.html`.

### Source Certificates (Artists)
Working artists on Attesté issue authoritative **source certificates** at the moment of sale or donation. A source certificate is the gold-standard provenance record — when an artist marks a work as authentic and tied to a specific buyer, that record becomes the canonical historical evidence collectors carry forward through every subsequent sale. Galleries and auction houses cite these certificates as primary-source provenance.

### Discovery Trails
Curated GPS-gated art walks through neighbourhoods in major cities. Tap to unlock each stop's artwork description, artist story, gallery info, and encounter-log entry. Launch cities include Cape Town (Woodstock, Bo-Kaap, Gardens), Johannesburg (Braamfontein, Maboneng), London (Shoreditch, Mayfair), and New York (Chelsea, Lower East Side).

### AI Art Sommelier
A short quiz (10-15 minutes) that profiles the collector's aesthetic preferences across 8 axes:
- Representational ↔ Abstract
- Bright ↔ Muted
- Quiet ↔ Energetic
- Traditional ↔ Experimental
- Figurative ↔ Conceptual
- Warm ↔ Cool palette
- Hand-made ↔ Digital
- Intimate ↔ Monumental scale

The resulting "taste profile" drives personalised artwork recommendations and gallery suggestions. Updatable; evolves as the collector's library grows.

### Atelier (Voice + Vision Companion)
Attesté's signature experience: a voice-first AI art companion built on Gemini Live, with live camera vision. Point your camera at an artwork and talk about it aloud — the AI sees what you see in real time and answers questions about style, technique, period, and the work's own documented provenance. Each session is saved as an Atelier Journal entry pinned to the artwork, so conversations become part of the collection's story. Premium-tier feature (sessions are capped for cost control). Atelier supersedes the earlier voice companion ("The Curator").

### Almanac + Daily Pulse (Galleries — rolling out now)
The new Attesté gallery experience. Every morning a Pulse briefing is computed overnight from real collector activity — new encounters, watchlists, certificate scans, inquiries — with suggested next actions. The Almanac AI concierge (Professional+ tiers) answers questions about the gallery's live inventory, collectors, and pipeline in voice or text. A cross-role activity stream collects every collector interaction with the gallery's works with zero CRM data entry. Six AI generators draft exhibition copy, artist bios, artwork descriptions, follow-up emails, on-demand insights, and an annual shareable "Gallery Wrapped". Multi-venue support scales by tier.

### Art Fair Companion
Rapid encounter logging optimised for busy art fairs. One-tap capture of:
- Photo of the artwork
- Gallery booth (auto-detected via geofence)
- Price (spoken or typed)
- Personal tag ("interested", "love", "compare with X")
- Follow-up reminder

Works offline; syncs when the fair Wi-Fi cooperates. Bulk review and contact-the-gallery flow afterwards.

### Encounter Logging
Beyond art fairs — every time a collector sees an artwork worth remembering (gallery visit, friend's home, museum, auction preview), Attesté captures the moment. Searchable, filterable, tied to GPS location, timestamped.

### Collector Gamification (XP & Levels)
Documenting artworks, completing trails, attending fairs, and adding provenance details all award XP. Collectors progress through levels (Apprentice → Explorer → Connoisseur → Curator → Grand Master). Unlocks cosmetic badges and surfaces milestone moments. Entirely optional — gamification can be muted.

### Legacy Vault (Premium)
Allows collectors to archive the deep story behind each artwork:
- Artist interview transcripts or recordings
- Acquisition narrative
- Condition history with photo timestamps
- Provenance research notes
- Links to related artworks in the same collection

Designed to survive the collector. Estate inheritance flow allows transfer of full Vault data to named heirs.

### Year in Art
Annual recap (like Spotify Wrapped, for art): artworks added, trails walked, galleries visited, aesthetic profile evolution, XP earned, "most-admired artist" of the year. Shareable as a one-page summary or a video clip.

### Public Collector Profile
Optional. Premium collectors can publish a curated view of their collection publicly. Galleries and fellow collectors can follow. Full privacy controls — specific artworks can always be hidden.

### Public Artist Profile
Working artists on Studio or Professional tiers publish a gallery-grade public page at `atteste.art/artist/{handle}` with bio, signature, statement, exhibition history (Pro tier), and a curated portfolio. Searchable inside the app and indexed for the open web.

### Verification Inbox (Artists)
Collectors and galleries request authentication directly from artists via the Verification Inbox. The artist decides what's verified — one tap to confirm or deny — without back-channel emails or low-resolution photographs.

### For Galleries: Annual Subscription Plans
Pure digital annual subscriptions. **No physical kit, no setup fees.** Three tiers (Boutique / Professional / Enterprise) covering inventory, exhibitions, anonymous collector analytics, AI-generated social tools, and a measurable collector pipeline.

## Pricing — all tiers

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Attesté Explorer | Free | Free | 25 | 5 / month | Collection management for up to 25 artworks, basic Discovery Trails (curated walks in supported cities), encounter logging, XP gamification, in-app Discovery Feed, community-grade support |
| Attesté Collector | $9.99 / month | $99.99 / year (save ~17%) | 200 | 50 / month | Up to 200 artworks, 50 AI analyses/month, Attesté Certificates, AI Art Sommelier, Art Fair Companion, full Discovery Trails |
| Attesté Premium | $19.99 / month | $199.99 / year (save ~17%) | Unlimited | Unlimited | Unlimited artworks and AI analyses, Atelier voice + vision companion, Legacy Vault, Year in Art, Condition Vault, Auction Intelligence, public collector profile, priority support |
| Attesté Patron | Free | Free | Unlimited | Unlimited | By invitation. Resolves to Premium plus a Patron badge and early access to new features. |

### Artist tiers (B2A)

| Tier | Monthly price | Annual price | Works | Source certificates | Key features |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Studio | $14.99 / month | $149.99 / year (save ~17%) | 50 | 5 / month | 14-day free trial for new subscribers. Public artist profile at `atteste.art/artist/{handle}`, basic analytics, Verification Inbox |
| Professional | $24.99 / month | $249.99 / year (save ~17%) | 500 | Unlimited | AI-assisted descriptions, exhibition history, priority verification, collector reach analytics, advanced Verification Inbox |
| Represented | Free (gallery-paid) | — | Unlimited | Unlimited | Provisioned by galleries on Professional or Enterprise plans. Artist signs up under the gallery's umbrella, no direct billing |

### Gallery tiers (B2B)

| Tier | Annual price | Monthly equivalent | Artworks | Exhibitions | Key features |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Gallery Boutique | $64.99 / month | — | 50 | 6 / year | Anonymous aggregate collector analytics, gallery directory listing, 30% off the first 12 months for the first 25 founding galleries (≈$45.49/mo) |
| Gallery Professional | $158.99 / month | — | 100 | 12 / year | Talking Provenance (Curator's Commentary), AI-generated exhibition social posts (Instagram, LinkedIn), content calendar, full collector pipeline, time-series analytics |
| Gallery Enterprise | $259.00 / month | — | Unlimited | Unlimited | AI artist reports, push campaigns to matched collectors (opt-in only, POPIA-compliant), priority support, dedicated account manager |

All gallery tiers include collector analytics that are **aggregate-only** — Attesté never shares individual visitor data with galleries. Founding gallery discount applies on Boutique only.

## Typical user journeys

### Journey 1 — The inheritor
"My father passed away and I've inherited his art collection. I don't know anything about it."
1. Download Attesté (free Explorer tier)
2. Walk through the collection with phone camera → AI Art Scout identifies each piece
3. Log encounters with basic context
4. Upgrade to Premium ($19.99/mo) to unlock Legacy Vault + unlimited artworks
5. Import any paper provenance documents (photograph them in place)
6. Build up a month-by-month understanding; publish a curated public profile in memoriam

### Journey 2 — The gallery-goer
"I see amazing pieces at galleries every weekend but I never follow up."
1. Free Explorer tier + Art Fair Companion
2. Log every encounter with a 3-second photo + tap
3. Review accumulated "to follow up on" list weekly
4. Use Sommelier to profile taste; get recommendations matching it
5. Upgrade to Collector ($9.99/mo) when ready to issue first certificate on their first acquisition

### Journey 3 — The serious collector
"I have 40 pieces across three homes. I need to consolidate my records."
1. Start with Collector or Premium directly
2. Bulk-document collection over 2-3 weekends
3. Issue Attesté Certificates for every piece
4. Review valuations, condition reports, acquisition sources
5. Set up Legacy Vault if planning estate handover
6. Publish a curated public profile for gallery follows

### Journey 4 — The working artist
"I want to issue real source certificates and have a public studio page collectors can find."
1. Start a 14-day Studio trial ($14.99/mo)
2. Set up the public artist profile (`atteste.art/artist/{handle}`)
3. Upload existing studio archive (50 works on Studio, 500 on Pro)
4. Issue source certificates for active sales (5/mo on Studio, unlimited on Pro)
5. Use the Verification Inbox to confirm or decline collector and gallery authentication requests
6. Upgrade to Professional when needing AI-assisted descriptions, exhibition history, and analytics

### Journey 5 — The gallery
"I want to understand my collector base without surveilling them."
1. Start with Boutique ($64.99/mo) — founding-gallery 30% discount applies for the first 12 months for the first 25 galleries
2. Upload up to 50 featured pieces, list 6 exhibitions
3. Access aggregate analytics dashboard: which pieces got encounter-logged, taste-profile match with visitors
4. Upgrade to Professional ($158.99/mo) when needing Curator's Commentary, AI-generated social posts, content calendar, and collector pipeline
5. Upgrade to Enterprise ($259.00/mo) for unlimited scale and opt-in push campaigns

## FAQs

**Q: What makes Attesté different from a spreadsheet or a photo album?**
A: Attesté combines AI identification (no more "what's this artist's name again?"), cryptographic provenance (tamper-proof record of ownership + condition history), artist source certificates (gold-standard provenance from the source), a searchable, location-aware, aesthetically-profiled system, and a gallery + artist ecosystem. Spreadsheets can't do AI identification or cryptographic integrity; photo albums can't do provenance, source certificates, or recommendations.

**Q: Is my art collection data private?**
A: Yes. By default, every collection is private. Public profiles require an explicit opt-in per collection. Firebase backend runs in `africa-south1` (Johannesburg data residency), so personal data never leaves Africa by default. POPIA and GDPR compliance are core. Mature content (artistic nudity) is blurred by default and requires opt-in.

**Q: What AI models does Attesté use? Where does my data go?**
A: Artwork photographs are analysed by Google's Gemini 2.5 Flash (vision API). Text reasoning uses Claude. Voice features use Gemini Live. Every image upload is also screened by Cloud Vision SafeSearch for content moderation. These are all disclosed at onboarding with an explicit consent gate (Terms, Privacy, Age 18+, Community Guidelines). You can opt out of AI features; you keep the collection database regardless.

**Q: Does Attesté guarantee my artwork is authentic?**
A: For pre-existing works, no — Attesté creates tamper-proof records of **what you reported**. Authentication remains a gallery, auction house, or expert's job. **For works originating on Attesté with an artist source certificate**, the artist confirmed authorship at the source — this is the gold standard. For inherited or bought works, you can attach professional authentication documents to your Attesté Certificate.

**Q: How accurate is AI Art Scout?**
A: Very good for well-known artists and clearly-photographed works. Lower confidence for obscure artists, poor-light photographs, or heavily damaged pieces. Every identification includes an explicit confidence score; low-confidence guesses are flagged for human verification. Artist's `provenanceQuality` score (0-5) caps AI confidence.

**Q: Can I export my data?**
A: Yes. Premium tier includes full export (JSON + PDF catalogue). POPIA / GDPR compliance requires data export on request for all tiers.

**Q: Can I use Attesté offline?**
A: Yes, for core documentation. Photograph artworks, log encounters, add notes — all works offline. AI identification and cloud sync happen when you reconnect.

**Q: Who built Attesté?**
A: Yield SPM (Pty) Ltd. The same team operates Practacular (AI practice management for accountants), so Attesté benefits from shared AI infrastructure.

**Q: Is Attesté available in my country?**
A: The app is live globally on the Apple App Store (since 2026-06-11); the Google Play listing follows on approval of the Android build currently in review. Pricing is USD primary; local equivalents render in the user's storefront currency (the stores handle conversion). The app provides localised currency display and a country picker covering 30 priority markets (with an "Other" fallback). Privacy Policy v1.1 has explicit regional addenda for POPIA (South Africa), GDPR (EU/EEA), and CCPA/CPRA (California), plus general provisions covering all other jurisdictions at GDPR-grade safeguards. Ask `info@atteste.art` for the latest on your market.

**Q: How do galleries use Attesté?**
A: Galleries join on a monthly subscription sold via the web — Boutique ($64.99/mo), Professional ($158.99/mo), or Enterprise ($259.00/mo). They get inventory and exhibition tools, an aggregate collector analytics dashboard, AI-generated exhibition posts, a daily Pulse briefing, the Almanac AI concierge (Professional+), and a measurable collector pipeline. Analytics are aggregate-only — individual collector data is never shared with galleries.

**Q: How do artists use Attesté?**
A: Artists subscribe directly (Studio $14.99/mo with 14-day trial, or Professional $24.99/mo) to get a public profile, catalogue their studio archive, issue source certificates, and manage authentication requests via the Verification Inbox. Artists represented by a gallery on Professional or Enterprise can be provisioned for free under the Represented tier.

**Q: What's an artist source certificate?**
A: When a working artist on Attesté marks a work as authentic and tied to a specific sale, that record becomes the gold-standard provenance for the work. Subsequent owners carry it forward; auction houses, galleries, and insurers can cite the certificate URL as primary-source provenance.

**Q: What's on the roadmap?**
A: Voice Stories (recording UI), Art Fair seed data, additional Discovery Trail cities, gallery subscription expiry/renewal automation, artist tier billing, EU/UK GDPR Representative appointment, POPIA Information Officer registration, PhotoDNA integration, NCMEC CyberTipline API access, stolen-art database cross-check.

## Integrations and compatibility

- **Google Maps** — encounter GPS + gallery discovery
- **Firebase Auth** — Google, Apple, email/password sign-in
- **Sign in with Apple** — wired, parity with Google Sign-In on iOS and web
- **Gemini 2.5 Flash** — vision and fast generation
- **Claude** — sommelier reasoning and provenance narrative
- **Gemini Live** — voice + vision companion (Atelier) and gallery concierge (Almanac)
- **Cloud Vision SafeSearch** — image moderation gate on every upload
- **RevenueCat** — subscription orchestration
- **Apple StoreKit 2** — iOS billing
- **Google Play Billing** — Android billing
- **NFC reader** — provenance tag scanning on physical artworks
- **QR scanning** — verification of certificate URLs

## Comparison with other platforms

### vs Artwork Archive (artworkarchive.com)
Artwork Archive is a web-first collection management SaaS targeted at artists and collectors. Mature product, large user base. Attesté differentiates with AI identification, cryptographic certificates, artist source certificates, discovery trails, aesthetic profiling, the Atelier voice + vision companion, and a three-persona ecosystem (collector ↔ artist ↔ gallery).

### vs Collector Systems
Collector Systems is an enterprise-focused collection management platform. High-end, professional. Attesté is consumer-accessible (free tier) and AI-native, while offering a path up to artist, gallery and institutional tiers.

### vs My Art Collection
My Art Collection is a simple inventory app. Attesté offers AI identification, cryptographic provenance, source certificates, discovery trails, gamification, and a gallery + artist ecosystem that simple inventory apps lack.

### vs Artlogic / Arternal
Artlogic and Arternal are gallery-first CRMs. They serve galleries managing collectors. Attesté inverts the model — it serves collectors first, then artists, then galleries, with shared verification primitives across all three.

### vs NFT platforms (OpenSea, etc.)
Attesté is about cataloguing physical and digital artworks a collector owns — with cryptographic integrity of the record itself, not on-chain ownership. Attesté is complementary to NFT collections, not an NFT platform.

---

## What Attesté is NOT

- Not an authentication service for pre-existing third-party works (it preserves records and source certificates from artists, but does not certify a Picasso is real)
- Not an insurance platform (doesn't provide coverage; can export reports for insurers)
- Not an auction house or marketplace (doesn't sell artworks)
- Not an NFT minting platform
- Not a gallery-only CRM (collectors are the primary user; artists and galleries are second and third)
